settings.perso_placeholder: Your unit, colours, branding and base
settings.s1_body: A containerised plant is hard to picture from a datasheet. We reproduce your unit as an accurate scale model - hoppers, pipework, valves and the branded container shell - so clients can see exactly how it is configured. Built from your drawings and finished on a base, it is a powerful showcase for meetings, exhibitions and corporate gifting.

settings.case_quote: Clients finally saw how our unit fits together. A brilliant talking point on the stand.
